stair.en: One stair near the entrance was marked for repair.
stair.zh: 入口附近有一階樓梯被標記等待維修。

stake.en: Everyone understood what was at stake before the final vote.
stake.zh: 最後表決前，每個人都了解事情的重要性。

stale.en: The bread became stale after being left uncovered overnight.
stale.zh: 麵包整晚沒有覆蓋，隔天變得不新鮮。

stall.en: A fruit stall opened near the station every morning.
stall.zh: 每天早上車站附近都會有一個水果攤。

stamp.en: She placed a stamp on the envelope before mailing it.
stamp.zh: 她寄信前在信封上貼了一張郵票。

stance.en: The article explains the committee's stance on the proposal.
stance.zh: 文章說明委員會對這項提案的立場。

stand.en: Please stand behind the line until the bus arrives.
stand.zh: 公車到站前請站在線後方。

staple.en: Rice is a staple food in many parts of Asia.
staple.zh: 米飯是亞洲許多地區的主食。

star.en: A bright star appeared above the mountain after sunset.
star.zh: 日落後，一顆明亮的星星出現在山上方。

stare.en: It is impolite to stare at people for a long time.
stare.zh: 長時間盯著別人看是不禮貌的。

startle.en: The sudden bell may startle anyone standing near the speaker.
startle.zh: 突然的鈴聲可能會嚇到站在喇叭附近的人。

statesman.en: The biography describes the statesman as an influential public figure.
statesman.zh: 這本傳記把那位政治家描述為有影響力的公眾人物。

station.en: We met outside the station before taking the train.
station.zh: 我們搭火車前在車站外碰面。

stationary.en: The bicycle remained stationary while the rider adjusted the seat.
stationary.zh: 騎士調整座椅時，自行車保持靜止。

stationery.en: The school store sells notebooks and other stationery supplies.
stationery.zh: 學校商店販售筆記本和其他文具用品。

statistical.en: The report includes statistical evidence from several recent surveys.
statistical.zh: 報告包含數份近期調查的統計證據。

statue.en: A stone statue stands in the center of the garden.
statue.zh: 花園中央矗立著一座石雕像。

stature.en: The scientist gained international stature through decades of research.
stature.zh: 這位科學家經過數十年研究獲得國際聲望。

status.en: You can check the application status on the school website.
status.zh: 你可以在學校網站查詢申請狀態。

statute.en: The class examined an old statute during the law lesson.
statute.zh: 班上在法律課中研究了一條舊法規。

steady.en: She made steady progress by practicing a little every day.
steady.zh: 她每天練習一點，因此穩定進步。

steak.en: The restaurant menu lists steak with several side dishes.
steak.zh: 餐廳菜單列有牛排和幾種配菜。

steal.en: The story shows why it is wrong to steal someone else's property.
steal.zh: 這個故事說明偷竊他人財物是不對的。

steam.en: Steam rose from the hot soup on the table.

steel.en: The bridge uses steel beams to support its main structure.
steel.zh: 這座橋使用鋼樑支撐主要結構。

steep.en: The trail becomes steep near the top of the hill.
steep.zh: 步道接近山頂時變得陡峭。

steer.en: The guide helped steer the discussion back to the main topic.
steer.zh: 主持人協助把討論帶回主要議題。

stem.en: The flower's stem bent slightly in the strong wind.
stem.zh: 花莖在強風中微微彎曲。

stepchild.en: The novel follows a stepchild adjusting to a new household.
stepchild.zh: 小說描寫一名繼子女適應新家庭的過程。

stepfather.en: Her stepfather attended the school concert with the family.
stepfather.zh: 她的繼父和家人一起參加學校音樂會。

stepmother.en: The character's stepmother encourages her to continue studying.
stepmother.zh: 故事中的繼母鼓勵她繼續讀書。

stereo.en: The old stereo still works well in the music room.
stereo.zh: 音樂教室裡的舊音響仍然運作良好。

stereotype.en: The lesson asks students to question a common stereotype.
stereotype.zh: 這堂課要求學生質疑一個常見刻板印象。

stew.en: The cafeteria served vegetable stew on the cold afternoon.
stew.zh: 寒冷的午後，學校餐廳供應蔬菜燉湯。

stick.en: A small stick blocked the wheel of the cart.
stick.zh: 一根小木棍卡住了推車的輪子。

sticky.en: The table felt sticky after the juice was spilled.
sticky.zh: 果汁灑出後，桌面摸起來黏黏的。

stiff.en: The new shoes felt stiff during the first few days.
stiff.zh: 新鞋前幾天穿起來有些僵硬。

stimulate.en: Good questions can stimulate deeper thinking during class discussions.
stimulate.zh: 好的問題可以在課堂討論中激發更深入的思考。

stimulation.en: The activity provides mental stimulation through puzzles and discussion.
stimulation.zh: 這項活動透過謎題與討論提供腦力刺激。

stimulus.en: The bell acted as a stimulus for the experiment response.
stimulus.zh: 鈴聲在實驗中作為引發反應的刺激。

sting.en: A bee sting can cause temporary pain and swelling.
sting.zh: 蜜蜂螫傷可能造成短暫疼痛與腫脹。

stingy.en: The character seems stingy because he refuses to share anything.
stingy.zh: 這個角色因為什麼都不願分享而顯得小氣。

stink.en: The trash began to stink after sitting outside all day.
stink.zh: 垃圾在外面放了一整天後開始發臭。

stir.en: Please stir the soup gently before serving it.

stitch.en: One stitch came loose along the edge of the bag.
stitch.zh: 袋子邊緣有一針線鬆開了。

stock.en: The store keeps extra stock in a room behind the counter.
stock.zh: 商店把額外庫存放在櫃台後方的房間。

stocking.en: A red stocking hung beside the classroom holiday display.
stocking.zh: 教室節慶布置旁掛著一隻紅色長襪。

stomach.en: The diagram shows where the stomach is located in the body.
stomach.zh: 圖表顯示胃在身體中的位置。

stomachache.en: He told the teacher he had a stomachache during class.
stomachache.zh: 他上課時告訴老師自己肚子痛。

stone.en: A smooth stone lay beside the river path.
stone.zh: 河邊小徑旁有一顆光滑的石頭。
